description: MonitorBankRates proprietary indexes. "hai" = MBR Housing Affordability Index (daily; 100 = median household exactly affords the median home at today's average 30-year rate; higher is more affordable), with national score, state score and rank, and 90-day history; with a city, the city score, its rank in the state, and the home value, income and payment behind it. "hibi" = Home Insurance Burden Index and "aibi" = Auto Insurance Burden Index (annual; 100 = U.S. average burden; higher is heavier), with state rankings plus an estimated monthly homeowners or car insurance cost for the state or city, by insurer, with the cheapest insurer.

city.description: Optional city name (needs state), e.g. Stamford. hai: city score, rank and inputs. hibi/aibi: city insurance cost estimate by insurer.

state.description: Optional two-letter state code or name.

name: get_index
title: Housing affordability and insurance indexes
